recipes.name: Chickpea Caesar Salad Wrap
instructions: To make the chickpea croutons, add the chickpeas, oil, and salt to a medium pan over high heat*. Cook and stir often for 14 minutes, until golden. Then set aside. The chickpeas will become more crisp as they cool.
Meanwhile, in a small bowl, mix together all of the dressing ingredients. In another bowl, mash the chickpeas reserved for the wrap. Mix the mashed chickpeas with half of the dressing.
To assemble, add the lettuce on the wrap, followed by the mashed chickpeas, chickpea croutons, and drizzle the dressing overtop.
Fold in the sides of the wrap, then roll the wrap shut. Serve with any remaining dressing on the side, and enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † Our large tortillas measure about 10 inches (25 cm) in diameter. * Alternatively, mix the chickpeas, oil, and salt in a bowl. Microwave for 7 minutes at 600 W. Stir and microwave again for another 7 minutes, or until golden. The serving of chickpeas for croutons is separate from the chickpeas set aside for the wrap.

Storage The assembled wrap should be enjoyed the day it's made. Unassembled components of the wrap can be stored in airtight container s in the fridge for up to 2 days. Note that the chickpeas will lose their crispiness when refrigerated.
